Summary: [SCRUM-62] Auth: Access token -> HttpOnly cookie + CSRF double-submit
Description:
Chuyen access token tu localStorage sang HttpOnly cookie (chong XSS doc token bang JS) + co che CSRF double-submit. Phan 1/3 cua dot dai tu auth. Vuot scope SCRUM-42, DOI hop dong response auth: bo accessToken khoi body (login/register/google), token nay nam trong cookie.

Backend:
- AuthCookieService: set cookie wh_access (HttpOnly) + wh_csrf (double-submit), clear khi logout.
- AuthController: tra AuthResultDto (user + expiresIn, khong token); logout xoa cookie.
- JwtBearer OnMessageReceived: doc token tu cookie (fallback Authorization Bearer cho Swagger/Postman).
- CsrfMiddleware: bat header X-CSRF-Token khop cookie tren request mutating CO cookie (Bearer bo qua).
- CORS opt-in Cors:AllowedOrigins + AllowCredentials (prod); Auth:CrossSiteCookies cho SameSite=None.

Frontend:
- api.ts: withCredentials + interceptor gan X-CSRF-Token tu cookie; bo tokenStore/Bearer.
- AuthContext.login(user) khong nhan token; /auth/me luon goi (cookie quyet dinh phien).
- authApi/GoogleCallback cap nhat theo AuthResultDto.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Login -> cookie wh_access (HttpOnly) + wh_csrf; response body KHONG con accessToken.
- F5 giu phien; logout xoa cookie -> /login.
- Request mutating thieu/sai X-CSRF-Token -> 403 CsrfError.
- Swagger/Postman van dung duoc qua Authorization Bearer.

Technical Notes:
- Khong co migration (khong doi schema).
- Dev khong can CORS (Vite proxy same-origin); prod set Cors:AllowedOrigins + Auth:CrossSiteCookies=true.
- Quyet dinh chi tiet: docs/CHANGELOG.md muc [2026-06-30]. Nhanh: feat/SCRUM-62-httponly-cookie-auth.

Chuyen tu stateless JWT sang co refresh token server-side luu Redis, co rotation. Phan 2/3 dot dai tu auth. Phu thuoc SCRUM-62.

Viec can lam:
- Access token TTL ngan (vd 15 phut); refresh token TTL dai (vd 7 ngay) luu Redis (key refresh:{jti} -> userId + metadata), set cookie wh_refresh (HttpOnly, Path=/api/auth/refresh).
- Endpoint POST /api/auth/refresh: cap access moi + XOAY refresh token moi, revoke token cu. Phat hien reuse token da revoke -> revoke ca family (chong token theft).
- Ha tang: them Redis qua docker-compose (wh-redis), doi AddDistributedMemoryCache -> AddStackExchangeRedisCache (dev fallback in-memory neu thieu Redis, log warning).
- Logout STATEFUL: revoke refresh token trong Redis + clear ca 3 cookie.
- FE: interceptor 401 -> goi /auth/refresh 1 lan -> retry request goc (single-flight queue tranh refresh don); refresh fail -> logout + ve /login.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Access het han -> /auth/refresh cap moi tu cookie wh_refresh, user khong bi dang xuat.
- Refresh token xoay moi lan dung; token cu bi revoke (Redis xoa key).
- Reuse refresh token da revoke -> tu choi + revoke family.
- Logout revoke refresh trong Redis.
- OAuth state (ConnectionsService dang dung IDistributedCache) tu dong chay tren Redis sau khi doi backing store.

Technical Notes:
- StackExchange.Redis; ConnectionStrings:Redis (vd localhost:6379).
- Quyet dinh chi tiet: docs/CHANGELOG.md muc [2026-06-30]. Nhanh: feat/SCRUM-63-refresh-token-redis.

Summary: [SCRUM-64] Auth: OTP dang ky qua SMS (Twilio)
Description:
Them xac minh so dien thoai bang OTP SMS khi dang ky. Phan 3/3 dot dai tu auth. Phu thuoc SCRUM-63 (dung Redis store cho OTP).

Flow (chot): tao account truoc, verify sau. Register tao user ngay voi PhoneVerified=false (+ cot Phone), gui OTP qua SMS; user nhap OTP o /auth/verify-otp de set PhoneVerified=true. Login CHAN user PhoneVerified=false (403 + tin hieu can verify) - tru Google Sign-In (bo qua OTP, khong co phone).

Viec can lam:
- Migration them Users.Phone (string null), Users.PhoneVerified (bool, default TRUE cho user cu de khong pha login hien co).
- ISmsSender (Application) + TwilioSmsSender (Infrastructure) doc Sms:Twilio:AccountSid/AuthToken/FromNumber tu config. Dev fallback LogSmsSender (ghi OTP ra log) khi chua cau hinh Twilio.
- OTP store Redis: key otp:{userId} -> ma 6 so (hash) + count, TTL 5 phut; rate-limit gui lai (cooldown 60s) + toi da N lan verify sai.
- Endpoint POST /api/auth/send-otp + POST /api/auth/verify-otp.
- FE: Register them field SDT; sau register dieu huong man nhap OTP (resend + dem nguoc).

Acceptance Criteria:
- Dang ky -> user PhoneVerified=false + nhan SMS OTP (hoac OTP trong log o dev).
- Nhap OTP dung -> PhoneVerified=true; login duoc.
- Login khi PhoneVerified=false -> 403 + tin hieu can verify.
- OTP sai/het han -> bao loi; resend co cooldown.
- Google Sign-In khong bi chan boi OTP.

Technical Notes:
- Twilio trial (du cho do an). Migration them cot Users -> chay dotnet ef database update.
- Quyet dinh chi tiet: docs/CHANGELOG.md muc [2026-06-30]. Nhanh: feat/SCRUM-64-register-otp-twilio.
